programs.title: 13 Hours to Survive
programs.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

director: Mark Woordward: Series Producer/Director, Emma Ross: Executive Producer

programs.title: 13 Hours to Survive
programs.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

director: Mark Woordward: Series Producer/Director, Emma Ross: Executive Producer

programs.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programs.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programs.title: Deep Dive Australia
programs.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward

programs.title: Deep Dive Australia
programs.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward

programs.title: Deep Dive Australia
programs.desc: Complete the trip’s final lap in the untamed lands where Australia’s interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward
